title: Ninasema tafadhali angalia mara mbili kila baada ya dakika 15

text.I say please double check about once eve: Ninasema tafadhali angalia mara mbili kila baada ya dakika 15
text.When we put in a config, we always do a: Tunapoweka usanidi, tunafanya ukaguzi mara mbili kila wakati.
text.There are places where the manual says “: Kuna mahali ambapo mwongozo unasema "angalia mara mbili hapa", na imejengwa ili siwezi kuweka usanidi peke yangu.
text.So I call out to my seniors and the peop: Kwa hivyo ninawaita wazee wangu na watu walio karibu nami wakisema "tafadhali angalia hii mara mbili", na ninaifanya kwa kiasi kikubwa.
text.At work, it feels like I say “please dou: Kazini, ninahisi kama nasema “tafadhali angalia mara mbili” takribani mara moja kila 15 dakika.
text.A night shift can leave me in the office: Zamu ya usiku inaweza kuniacha ofisini kwa takriban 20 saa
text.Network operations also means sending a: Uendeshaji wa mtandao wa pia inamaanisha kutuma mtu halisi kwenye tovuti
